description: Recurring bug classes as an executable registry. `detector.run` (when non-null) is a node command the test-suite runner executes; exit 0 = class currently held closed, non-zero = possible regression. status: covered (real detector) | partial (detector approximates) | gap (no detector yet — the suite's backlog).

classes.name: Hollow ladder rung (version bumped, no capsule)

detector.notes: Consumer-only: resolves the capsule for /mc:update (it needs --to). N/A in canonical (canonical is the source): scripts/testsuite/run.js runs it without arguments and reports a canonical failure as n/a.

na_when.reason: this product tree does not ship _mc/MANIFEST.json

detector.notes: A generated product tree (its ci/GENERATED first line is mc/public-repo-generated/v1) does not carry _mc/MANIFEST.json, so scripts/testsuite/run.js reports a failure of this detector there as n/a (na_when: the marker AND no _mc/MANIFEST.json). A tree without that marker, including one whose manifest was deleted, still fails, and so does a generated tree that carries a drifted _mc/MANIFEST.json.

Consumer/update-oriented: checks capsule release.json#migrations[] before /mc:update applies (it needs --to). N/A in canonical: scripts/testsuite/run.js runs it without arguments and reports a canonical failure as n/a.
lint-json-bom.js checks git-tracked JSON only; untracked machine-local stores are not scanned.
No standing detector. Candidate: lint scripts/ for execSync with backslash-escaped format strings / unquoted % on Windows.

classes.name: Windows stdin / argv limits in dispatch

detector.notes: Guard-test covers the route-guard watchlist; does not measure argv length directly.

classes.name: Route bypass of a lib-only fix

detector.notes: Not wired to a detector in this registry. Related standing check: scripts/checks/cutover-completeness.js fails on live retired path and role literals.
scan:references runs scripts/hooks/ref-checker.js; it is not wired into this registry as a detector.
Partial overlap with BC-12. scripts/checks/doc-ref-integrity.js catches repository citations to nonexistent targets; it is not wired into this registry as a detector.
scripts/check-guard-promotion.js is informational and always exits 0, so as a detector here it never reports a regression; the real signal is paths.enforcementDebt's high-severity entries.
Not wired to a detector in this registry. Related standing checks: scripts/checks/gate-failclosed-audit.js and scripts/checks/gate-failclosed-enforcer.js (permissive catch handlers in gates).
hooks:test measures firing + timing; no pass/fail self-sabotage detector. Hook latency is unmetered here.
Sprint-full integration tests cover some state transitions; not exhaustive on parallelism races.
Audits worktrees; does not directly assert CWD-relative tracker resolution.
Runtime/context phenomenon — not statically detectable. Candidate: a checkpoint-completeness assertion.

classes.name: Missing memory stores (registered, absent on disk)

detector.notes: Not detected: scripts/checks/mc-path-resolution.js (BC-13) skips owner=runtime and mutable path entries, which is how the memory stores (learnings, traces, recurring issues) are registered.
Process discipline: verify each gap reproduces in canonical. Not wired to a detector here; scripts/mc/test-sealed-capsule-gate.js exercises isolated consumer installs, which covers the consumer side.

BOM half: lint-json-bom.js (shared with BC-06). Embedded canonical absolute paths: scripts/mc/test-sealed-capsule-gate.js (BC-28) asserts a sealed install cannot reach the canonical tree. The git-identity half has no detector.

classes.name: Spec -> code -> test drift
classes.baseline_note: Tracked debt: lint-prds.js reports PRD-lint findings on the PRDs under the specs root. Known-red baseline — scripts/testsuite/enforce.js reports it but does not block on it, only on NEW reds. Remove this marker when the PRD-lint debt is cleared.

detector.notes: PRD lint approximates; full SPEC_GRAPH propagation + AC-coverage are the deeper signal (scan:requirements / scan:ac-coverage).

classes.name: Invented authoring format / missing etc harness gates

detector.notes: Rejects: root etc.md exists (namespace violation), etc/*.md missing standard frontmatter or ## Procedure, eval-packs failing the scan's minimal schema check, decision_records failing validate-artifact.js.

The sealed-capsule-contract-gate enforcer (ADR-0006). --self-test proves the gate logic fail-closed: seal materializes the full BOM + verifies hashes, isolate creates an out-of-tree repo and CATCHES a planted reach-back, lifecycle/matrix fail-closed per step/cell, verifyTyped requires action+well-formed-record (BC-16) in each cell's own ledger. The heavy real-matrix run is the on-demand --full / release-gate path (release-gates.js gate sealed_capsule_contract).

classes.name: Silent installer no-op in /portfolio:new (created project has no engine)

detector.notes: createProductRepo must install MC into a new product loudly: an install guarded on a canonical-clone-only script silently no-ops on a consumer install, leaving app files with no MC engine. Detector asserts the loud-install contract: installs via the SHIPPED install.ps1, enforces a .claude/framework-installed.json completeness gate, and FAILS LOUDLY (never a silent skip) — static source contract + injected-spawn behavioral checks (D1 no-op rejected, D2 failed-install rejected, D3 positive control).

classes.name: Enforcer shipped without its field (fail-closed validator declares required paths the capsule neither ships nor initializes)

detector.notes: A fail-closed validator (scripts/trackers/validate.js REQUIRED_PATHS) reports every missing required path as a failure, so it fails in a consumer project when the capsule delivers neither the required framework templates NOR an initializer. Detector asserts every consumer-required path a fail-closed validator declares is either SHIPPED (framework content in the manifest) or INITIALIZABLE (project content via a named initializer script+command). trackers/templates ship as owner=framework (build.js framework-trackers-templates rule + ASSET_DIRS), and /trackers:init (scripts/trackers/init.js + .claude/commands/trackers/init.md) produces a validator-GREEN seed. Extend DECLARERS[] when a new fail-closed validator declares consumer paths.
